::: {.section-intro}
I build and lead open-data communities and FAIR data tooling for the water, sanitation and hygiene (WASH) sector, and I write and manage the grants that fund them.
:::

## Open Data & Software

### [AGUASAN Workshop 2027 - Publishing WASH Data Together](https://github.com/Global-Health-Engineering/aguasan)
AGUASAN Community of Practice / SDC Water Network 

2026 - Current 

- Author of a topic proposal for a five-day working retreat where WASH-sector participants publish datasets while learning Git/GitHub, Quarto and safe use of AI agents; bridges academia (ETH), the WASH community and Swiss government. 



### [fairenough - tidy data into documented R packages](https://openwashdata.github.io/fairenough/)
Author 

2025 - Current 

- Converts tidy data into R packages with documentation websites and AI-assisted descriptions. 



### [jmpwashdata - WHO/UNICEF JMP data](https://github.com/larnsce/jmpwashdata)
Author 

2024 - Current 

- R package providing tidy access to WHO/UNICEF Joint Monitoring Programme WASH data. 



### [Data Science for openwashdata (ds4owd)](https://ds4owd-001.github.io/website/)
Course Creator & Instructor 

2023 - Current 

- Designed and taught two free online cohorts on literate programming with Quarto and R; hundreds of participants across many countries.
- Focus on data management, reproducibility and publishing open data. 



### [washr - R package for publishing openwashdata resources](https://openwashdata.github.io/washr/)
Author 

2023 - Current 

- An R package that makes publishing openwashdata data resources easier. 



### [openwashdata community](https://openwashdata.org)
Founder & Community Lead 

2022 - Current 

- Built and lead a global open-data community for the WASH sector; 90+ open datasets published as documented R data packages.
- Created the {washr} and {fairenough} R packages that turn tidy data into FAIR, documented data packages.
- See openwashdata.org 



### [rstatsZH - open course materials & infrastructure](https://rstats.zuerich/)
Creator & Maintainer 

2021 - Current 

- Built and maintain the open, reusable course materials, website templates and Git-based infrastructure behind the rstatsZH training programme (course delivery is under Teaching). 

## Grants & Funding

::: aside
Wrote and managed a portfolio of ETH Board Open Research Data grants worth roughly CHF 500,000 in total (2023-2026).
:::

### [openwashdata - establishing Data Stewards and increasing FAIRness](https://github.com/openwashdata-dev/prop-eth-ord-explore-02-openwashdata)
ETH Board ORD Program (Explore, 2nd call) 

2024 - Current 

- Wrote the proposal and manage the project (Prof. Elizabeth Tilley, PI). Places funded data stewards in partner organisations (UKZN, South Africa; BASEflow, Malawi) and delivers a 12-module data stewardship training programme. 



### [washcollab - Enhancing Global WASH Data Accessibility through Collaborative Initiatives](https://github.com/openwashdata-dev/prop-eth-ord-contribute-washweb)
ETH Board ORD Program (Contribute) 

2024 - Current 

- Wrote the proposal and manage the project (Prof. Elizabeth Tilley, PI). A partnership between WASHWeb and openwashdata maintaining open-source tools for authoritative WASH data (WHO/UNICEF JMP, World Bank, UN-Water GLAAS, OECD). 



### [FAIRqual - FAIR Data Practices for Qualitative Research in Transdisciplinarity](https://github.com/fairqual)
ETH Board ORD Program (Explore, Measure 1) 

2024 - 2025 

- Co-wrote the proposal and contributed to the project (team across TdLab and Global Health Engineering, ETH Zurich). Develops tools and standards for sharing hard-to-anonymise qualitative research data following FAIR principles. 



### [openwashdata - Open WASH data by building Open Science Competencies and Community](https://github.com/openwashdata-dev)
ETH Board ORD Program (Explore, 1st call) 

2023 - 2024 

- Wrote the proposal and managed the project (Prof. Elizabeth Tilley, PI). Built the infrastructure, community and FAIR data publishing workflow for open WASH data; 18 months. 



### [openjmp - Open JMP: unlocking the potential of global indicator data](https://ghe.ethz.ch/open-science/projects/openjmp.html)
ETH Board ORD Program (Contribute) 

2023 - 2024 

- Wrote the proposal and managed the project (Prof. Elizabeth Tilley, PI). In partnership with the WHO/UNICEF Joint Monitoring Programme, turns decades of WASH coverage data into documented open R packages; 15 months. 

## Awards

### [National Prize for Open Research Data 2024](https://mavt.ethz.ch/news-and-events/d-mavt-news/2024/12/national-prize-for-open-research-data.html)
Swiss Academies of Arts and Sciences 

2024 

- Awarded to openwashdata, the global open-data community for the WASH sector (project led by Prof. Elizabeth Tilley, Global Health Engineering, ETH Zurich).
- Recognition for advancing FAIR and Open Research Data practices in the water, sanitation and hygiene sector.
